messages:
maria: Heads-up — multiple enterprise customers (tenant: acme-corp, tenant: brightlane) started seeing SSO failures after yesterday's RBAC prep. SCIM provisioning throwing 403s and SAML log shows missing role attrs.

kevin: Which error in SCIM? paste logs?

maria: Paste from scim-provisioner logs:

```
2026-03-22T03:12:45Z ERROR provisioner.go:322 failed to decrypt envelope: kms:Decrypt failed, InvalidCiphertextException
tenant=acme-corp user=alice@example.com action=sync
HTTP 403 -> remote response: Forbidden
```

ash: looks like KMS rewrap at 2026-03-22T03:10:00Z. We rolled alias `alias/redwood/scim` to a new key id. Service principal still using old key ctx.

jen: Did the KMS rotation include re-encrypting existing envelopes? If not, decrypt will fail. Who triggered rotation?

deploy-bot: [deploy] rotation job `kms-rewrap-job` started by @ops at 2026-03-22T03:09:50Z

kevin: quick triage steps:
1) verify `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood/scim`
2) check scim-provisioner pod env var `KMS_KEY_ID`
3) run `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://envelope.bin --key-id <id>` from ops account

maria: I ran step 2 — scim-provisioner shows `KMS_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-key-id`

ash: confirmed alias now points to `key/new-key-id`. So decrypt fails for envelopes encrypted w/ old-key-id.

kevin: Mitigation: point alias back to old-key-id while we rewrap envelopes, or run a one-off rewrap job that reads old envelopes with old-key and re-encrypts with new key (requires access to old-key). Ops, can you rollback alias?

ops (jen): rollback requires approval. We can also run a background rewrap using the old-key if it's still accessible from the rotation job's temporary credentials. I'll check.

maria: Also noticed SAML assertions for impacted tenants lack the `roles` attribute; assertion examples show NameID and email but not roles. That caused downstream RBAC lookup to return empty -> 403 on provision.

kevin: Could be a change in authnproxy attribute mapping. Recent RBAC PR touched `saml-attrs` mapping around NameID formats.

jen: Repro steps for SAML sample:

```
<saml:Assertion ...>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress\">alice@example.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"email\"><saml:AttributeValue>alice@example.com</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
    <!-- roles attribute missing -->
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

ash: If NameID format changed, our mapping that extracts roles from `AttributeStatement/saml:Attribute[@Name='roles']` might skip. We should add fallback to split on `eduPersonEntitlement` or check claim mapping in the IdP.

maria: Plan: 1) ops check alias rollback or ensure old-key accessible for rewrap; 2) add transient authnproxy mapping fallback for missing roles (map groups->roles); 3) run backfill for users who failed provisioning; 4) open customer comms.

kevin: I'll own #2, will push a hotfix to authnproxy canary and add an alert if assertions missing roles > 5%.

ash: I'll run alias check now and report.

ash: alias check done — old-key still enabled but scheduled for deletion in 7 days. Ops needs to expedite rewrap or recover key snapshot.

jen: Opening incident ticket INC-20260322-17. Linking runbook.

maria: customer comms draft posted in #customer-success. Need ETA for fix please.

ops (jen): ETA for alias rollback 30m if approved, rewrap job could take ~2-3h for all affected envelopes.

kevin: Fine for now. After rollback, we should schedule proper rewrap with zero-downtime path.

maria: Thanks team. I'll update thread once rewrap starts.

ash: ping when warm rewrap job completes, will run verification script:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/v1/provision/verify -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp"}'
```

maria: Verified — after temporary alias rollback and rewrap, provisioning succeeded for acme-corp. Closing P2 for now, will keep monitoring :eyes:
